description: Fork of exp061 (val=1.7181 @ 8K). Single change: replace 6 per-layer positional embeddings with a single shared learnable pos table of shape [context_size, E], applied identically at every layer's input. Tests whether sharing pos info across depth concentrates more gradient signal per parameter (6x more updates per pos slot) and helps the small-E=96 model train better in 8K steps. Param cost: -245,760 (5 dropped pos tables of 49,152 each).
